function: CSI compression and feedback: variable-rate joint source-channel coding of the massive-MIMO downlink CSI matrix, with autoencoder plus residual-diffusion refinement at the BS (p. 1-2, 4).
system: FDD massive MIMO, BS ULA with Nt=32 antennas, single-antenna UE (Nr=1), Nc=32 subcarriers, uplink feedback at 5.4 GHz via QuaDRiGa; no RIS (p. 2, 7).
method: Supervised CNN autoencoder (MSE loss), then U-Net trained with residual-diffusion loss (x-prediction, 2-step inference); Matryoshka loss for variable rate (p. 4-6).
data_channel: COST2100 outdoor dataset (32x32 angular-delay CSI, 10^5 train, 2x10^4 test) and 3GPP TR 38.901 indoor open-area; QuaDRiGa generates the uplink feedback channel (p. 7, 10).
test_conditions: Separate model per dataset (COST2100 outdoor, 3GPP indoor), uplink SNR swept -10 to 10 dB; CSI-error test at CNR 0 dB; no cross-dataset test (p. 9, 11).
baselines: Learned only: ADJSCC [28] and DJSCC-CSINet+ [40] (small and large), U-Net-based JSCC (own variant), GD-JSCC [37] in ablation; no non-learned method in the experiments (p. 6, 8, 12).
metrics: NMSE of CSI reconstruction versus uplink SNR (-10 to 10 dB); uncoded BLER; throughput, parameters and FLOPs (p. 8-11).
complexity: Throughput in samples/s per module on GPU and CPU (Table III); parameters and FLOPs per module, e.g. RD-JSCC 2-step denoiser 13.9M parameters, 271.8M FLOPs (p. 10-11).
openness: Code released at github.com/UTAustin-ITML/rd-jscc (p. 1); COST2100 public dataset used (p. 7).
q1_support: p. 7: "We evaluate our method on the COST2100 outdoor dataset [53]"; p. 10: "the indoor open-area channel model specified in 3GPP TR 38.901 [55]".
q2_support: p. 9: "the smaller RD-JSCC model trained on the 3GPP indoor dataset" shows one model trained per dataset; the only mismatch is a CSI-error test (p. 11), which does not count.
q3_support: p. 6: "we benchmark against ADJSCC [28]" plus CSINet+ [40] and GD-JSCC [37], all learned; no non-learned method is simulated (compressed sensing appears only in the introduction, p. 1).
q4_support: p. 11: "Parameter counts and FLOPs comparison across methods" (Tables IV and V); p. 9: "measuring the throughput of each module" (Table III).
q5_support: p. 1: "Source code available at: github.com/UTAustin-ITML/rd-jscc."; the COST2100 dataset is also public.
notes: Preprint is arXiv 2505.21681v2 (18 Feb 2026). Area 2: the learned method compresses and feeds back the CSI, and the JSCC here serves that function. The BS has 32 antennas, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. q2 is 0 because each dataset has its own trained model and the CSI-error test is not a new scenario.
